user.title: Connect iCloud Drive
user.description: Sign in with your Apple ID. Backups are stored in the given folder of your iCloud Drive. Requirements: 'Access iCloud Data on the Web' must be enabled and Advanced Data Protection must be turned off.

data.folder: Folder in iCloud Drive (use / for subfolders)
data.china_mainland: Account is registered in mainland China

verification_code.title: Two-factor authentication
verification_code.description: Enter the 6-digit verification code that is shown on one of your trusted Apple devices for {username}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate iCloud
reauth_confirm.description: The iCloud session for {username} has expired. Enter your password to sign in again; you may be asked for a new verification code.

error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid. Please try again.
error.unsupported_auth: This account uses a sign-in method that is not supported (two-step verification or security keys).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already configured.
abort.security_key_unsupported: This account requires a hardware security key for sign-in, which is not supported.
abort.drive_unavailable: iCloud Drive is not reachable. Enable 'Access iCloud Data on the Web' and turn off Advanced Data Protection in your Apple ID settings, then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to iCloud Drive.
abort.folder_failed: Could not find or create the folder '{folder}' in iCloud Drive. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: iCloud Drive Backup

manual.title: Enter folder path
manual.description:
Currently used: {current}

Use / for subfolders, e.g. `Backup/HomeAssistant`. Missing folders are created. Existing backups are not moved.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Choose whether **iCloud Backup** appears in the sidebar. When hidden, the explorer stays available via the link in this dialog.

data.show_panel: Show the folder explorer in the sidebar

error.folder_failed: The folder could not be found or created in iCloud Drive. Check the log for details.
error.drive_unavailable: iCloud Drive is not reachable via the web API.
error.invalid_auth: The iCloud session has expired. Please re-authenticate the integration.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to iCloud Drive.
error.root_not_allowed: Please choose or create a folder – backups cannot be stored directly in the iCloud Drive root.
error.invalid_name: Invalid folder name (must not be empty or contain /).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Fix the connection (re-authenticate) first, then try again.
